name: assetpanda/page-directory
title: AP Page Directory
description: Directory grid of logo cards with optional category chips and an instant search: centred heading, a chip row built from the cards' tags (each with its count), a search box, then white cards (logo, name, tag pills, description, optional arrow link; the whole card is the link when it has a url), an optional 'more coming soon' tile and a closing line with a button. Built for /integrations/ (live's logo-expand gridder, every description shown instead of hidden behind a click; on phones long descriptions fold to three lines and a tap unfolds them) and the /compare/ guides. Filtering is behaviour.js; without it every card shows. This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
